announcements.title: Mid-Semester Examination Schedule Released
announcements.author: Examination Cell
announcements.message: The mid-semester examination schedule for all departments has been published. Exams will commence from October 20, 2026. Students are advised to check the department notice boards and the university portal for detailed timetables.

announcements.title: Campus Placement Drive — Infosys
announcements.author: Training & Placement Office
announcements.message: Infosys will conduct an on-campus placement drive on October 18, 2026. Eligible branches: CSE, IT, ECE. Minimum CGPA requirement: 7.0. Register on the placement portal before October 12.

announcements.title: Library Extended Hours During Exams
announcements.author: Central Library
announcements.message: The central library will remain open until 11:00 PM during the examination period (October 20 to November 5). Students must carry valid ID cards for entry after 8:00 PM.

announcements.title: Emergency: Water Supply Disruption
announcements.author: Campus Administration
announcements.message: Due to maintenance work on the main pipeline, water supply to Hostels A, B, and C will be disrupted on October 12 from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Tanker supply will be arranged. Please store water in advance.

announcements.title: Research Paper Submission Deadline Extended
announcements.author: Research & Development Cell
announcements.message: The deadline for submitting research papers for the Annual Research Symposium has been extended to November 1, 2026. Submit via the R&D portal. Contact rd@campus.edu for queries.

supportRequests.subject: WiFi Not Working in Hostel Block C
supportRequests.message: The WiFi connection in Hostel Block C, Room 312 has been down for the past three days. I have tried restarting the router and reconnecting but the issue persists. This is affecting my coursework submissions.

supportRequests.subject: Course Registration Error
supportRequests.message: I am unable to register for the Elective course Advanced Databases (CS-604). The portal shows section full but the department confirmed seats are available. Please resolve this urgently.

supportRequests.subject: Broken Desk in Lecture Hall 204
supportRequests.message: Three desks in Lecture Hall 204 (seats 15, 16, and 17) have broken writing boards. Students sitting there have to write on their laps. Please arrange repair or replacement.
